Headline: Co-Founder and CEO of Included Health
Bio:
CEO, Founder

Healthcare is not immune to innovation, it just acts like it. Our mission at Included Health is to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We create the products and culture to power better results for patients everywhere, now and in future. 

How? By making healthcare easier to understand, navigate, and afford. By providing healthcare that’s EQ + AI, tech-powered and human-driven. It includes everything: acute and chronic, physical and behavioral, in-person and virtual, medical and administrative. 

I’ve always been passionate about product strategy, not just what we’re building but how we build it. Before IH, I co-founded Reputation.com and grew it into the worldwide leader in online reputation and privacy management. Earlier, I pioneered eBay's unstructured data approach for understanding buyer behavior. My interest in healthcare began even earlier, in Accenture’s Health and Life Sciences practice. 

This work is complex so the solutions we provide can be simple. So being named one of the World Economic Forum’s Global Technology Pioneers, one of Goldman Sachs’ Top 50 Builders + Innovators, and Rock Health’s Most Beloved CEOs matters to me. It’s a direct reflection of the hard work and success of those around me, from engineers to clinicians, care team to admins. 

We're looking forward. Future healthcare will be powered by data, so clinicians know instantly who you are and how you want to be taken care of. It will make possible both digital and in-person experiences, at the right time, for speed, ease, and accuracy. It’ll be connective, including more people and providers. And it’ll be contextual, understanding your job, language, spiritual practice, and cultural identity all matter to your health. Most important, it will get results.

> $3,400 savings per obese member per year

How It Works
We use AI to synthesize clinical, genetic, gut microbiome, food, and behavioral data to deliver:
> Personalized Food-as-Medicine plans

You can't control healthcare costs without addressing biology. And you can't scale Precision Biology without Digbi Health.

I currently live in Southern California with my wife and four children near some of the best breaks on the West Coast.

Company description:
Our mission is to end the scourge of food-related chronic illness - obesity, metabolic, digestive, autoimmune, and mental health - for this and future generations to advance human longevity. It is possible for people to live longer and disease-free, and to achieve that, we're advancing care based on Food and Precision Biology, including genetics, the microbiome, and AI.

Digbi is committed to making personalized care universally accessible to individuals through their employers, insurance-covered plans, and Medicare, creating personalized, proactive, predictive, data-driven, and home-based care that turns food from a cause of illness into a means of medicine. 

With over 100 employers offering Digbi Health, Precision Biology isn't the future of care. It's the New Standard.

The Digbi Difference: Precision Biology at Scale
Digbi Health is the first multi-condition digital care platform powered by Precision Biology, addressing obesity, metabolic, digestive, autoimmune, and mental health conditions—the drivers of ~70% of controllable healthcare costs.
We 
> Deliver care for five conditions through a single platform.
> Target the root cause of illness  using genetics, gut microbiome, CGM, and AI
> Integrate Food-as-Medicine with national telehealth, supporting access to GLP-1s and other pharmacotherapies when clinically appropriate.

Proven Impact. Real ROI.
Employers choose Digbi because we deliver outcomes that show up on the balance sheet:
> $3,400 savings per obese member per year
> 60% fewer ER visits
> 49% fewer inpatient admissions
> 36% reduction in prescription utilization

How It Works
We use AI to synthesize clinical, genetic, gut microbiome, food, and behavioral data to deliver:
> Personalized Food-as-Medicine plans
> GLP-1 clinical care optimizing for managing adverse effects, adherence, and off-ramping.
You can't control healthcare costs without addressing biology. And you can't scale Precision Biology without Digbi Health.
